history.content: didnt get the thing at work. they gave it to someone else
That sounds like a sharp miss, especially when it was something you were aiming for.
its not even the role. its that my manager looked me in the eye last month and said i was next in line
Ah, so it is not the role itself, it is the gap between what you were told and what happened. Did it land more like being misled, or more like being passed over?
misled i guess. but worse than that. like i actually believed her. i told my partner it was basically done
Misled fits, and the part that seems to sting harder is that you believed her and had already said it out loud to your partner. What does that feel like in you, if you stay with it for a second?
stupid. like i should have known better. i always do this. trust someone and then im the idiot standing there

That sounds less like the event itself and more like turning it back on yourself, with a harsh kind of self-blame. I’m wondering if the sharper edge is embarrassment, shame, or just that sinking feeling of being left holding the loss alone.
i dont know. its both. im angry at her but mostly im just sitting here wondering whats wrong with me that people keep doing this
I’m holding both, then, the anger at her and the harder question turning inward. It sounds like the self-blame is louder right now, with that exposed, “what’s wrong with me” feeling underneath.
yeah. exposed is the word. like everyone in that office can see i wasnt good enough and i was dumb enough to think i was
That exposed feeling makes sense here, especially with the thought that everyone can see it. It sounds like something in you wants to hide or fold in on itself a bit, does that fit?
yeah it does. i called in sick today honestly. couldnt face walking past her office
That feels like the moment turned into proof, not just embarrassment. If you want, we can stay with what it seemed to say about you, or leave it here for now.
proof. yeah. thats exactly it. like it confirmed the thing ive always been scared is true about me
That lands as the moment becoming “proof” of a fear that was already waiting there. If you want to stay with it, we can look at what that thing about you is, or we can leave it here.
not today. i cant go there right now. but it helped to say it out loud. thanks
Of course, we can leave it here. I’m glad saying it out loud gave it a little more room.
